summary.zh: 用 goroutine 与 channel 构建并发程序
summary.en: Build concurrent Go with goroutines and channels

description.zh: 讲解 goroutine、channel、context 与同步原语的组合用法，包括 worker pool 和取消传播。适合在编写并发 Go 程序或定位数据竞争与死锁时参考。数据竞争检测依赖 Go 工具链自带的 race detector。
description.en: Covers goroutines, channels, context, and sync primitives, with worker pools and cancellation. Use it when writing concurrent Go or tracking down races and deadlocks; race detection relies on the Go toolchain.
